blind.description: An arched iron crypt or dungeon gate. It consists of an arched outer frame, five vertical iron bars, two horizontal reinforcement bands with round rivet heads, a solid kick plate at the base adorned with a diamond stud, two wall hinges on one edge, and a ring-pull handle latch assembly on the opposite edge. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and clean, with a dark, weathered wrought-iron metallic finish and edge highlights.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal bar representing the gate's top frame, with rounded hinge barrels on the left and a latch bracket with hanging ring on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 4.8 to 5.0 feet tall (reaching about shoulder-height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3.0 feet wide.

notes: Footprint is slightly deeper than requested due to hinges and latch hardware.
